articles.title: PREVIEW: Blackhawks Head to New York to Face Islanders

away.summary: The Hurricanes (3-1-1) are coming off a 6-4 win over Montreal and are projected to start Pyotr Kochetkov in net after Brandon Bussi's recent start. Seth Jarvis remains out with a shoulder injury, though he has progressed to practicing in a standard sweater. The team is riding strong performances from Sebastian Aho and Andrei Svechnikov, with Aho tied for third in league goal-scoring through four games.

out.detail: Suspended (two games for illegal check to the head)

home.summary: The Blackhawks (1-4-0) are projected to start Spencer Knight in goal, with Connor Bedard and Andrew Mangiapane out due to injuries and Frank Nazar serving a suspension. Teuvo Teravainen is returning to the lineup after missing the previous game with a lower-body injury. The team has been getting contributions from younger players, with 65.2% of their points coming from players 25 or younger.
